description: This file defines the Lead class, representing a lead entity within the SuiteCRM system, extending from Person and implementing EmailInterface. It includes properties related to lead information, methods for fetching associated account, opportunity, and contact data, query builders, conversion logic, and other CRM-specific functionalities.

classes.name: Lead
classes.description: Represents a lead in the SuiteCRM system, including properties for lead details and methods for data retrieval, list queries, conversion, and integration with related entities.

methods.name: get_account
methods.description: Retrieves the associated account information based on the account_id property, updating account_name and owner fields.

methods.name: get_opportunity
methods.description: Fetches the related opportunity details and updates relevant fields.

methods.name: get_contact
methods.description: Loads contact info associated with the lead and formats the name using locale settings.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to list leads with optional filtering and ordering.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Generates a new list query, augmenting the select clause with account name information.

methods.name: converted_lead
methods.description: Marks a lead as converted and links it with contact, account, and opportunity IDs, updating status.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields for list views, including account info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates detailed view fields including contact, opportunity, account, and campaign info.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Returns formatted list view data, supplementing with account name if missing.

methods.name: get_linked_fields
methods.description: Returns fields that are of type 'link', representing related entity links.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a dynamic WHERE clause for search, matching last name, first name, account, email, and phone details.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Prepares email notification content with lead details for templating.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface; here, providing ACL support.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Supports ACL security in list views, enabling/hiding links based on user permissions for related entities.

methods.name: convertCustomFieldsForm
methods.description: Transfers custom lead fields during lead conversion, generating form HTML for custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the lead object to database, setting default status if empty.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Retrieves SQL to find emails not linked to the lead.

methods.name: get_old_related_calls
methods.description: Builds SQL to find calls related to the lead created before version 5.1.

methods.name: getActivitiesOptions
methods.description: Static method returning options for lead conversion activities.

methods.name: get_old_related_meetings
methods.description: Builds SQL to find meetings related to the lead created before version 5.1.
